title: Kevin Stefanski: Now is not the time to know if Michael Penix will play Thursday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kevin Stefanski: Now is not the time to know if Michael Penix will play Thursday
sources.description: The Falcons fell to 0-2 in a 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday and head coach Kevin Stefanski said after the game that it was an "extremely disappointing" performance by his team.
